phase_a_preservation_and_branch_hygiene.details: Preserved Stage 1–9 + NVIDIA modules; all work isolated to feature/geos-v2-foundation; main untouched.

implemented_features: Sentinel-2 L2A pre-monsoon 2024 NDVI + clear-obs QA
NASA GPM IMERG 10-year daily archive (3,439 valid / 214 null days)
NOAA GFS 0.25 deg experimental 72h forecast (Dynamical.org Zarr v3)
GSI Bhusanket public inventory (379 in-district) + NASA COOLR (19 in-district)
Live OpenStreetMap transport (2,212 roads, 392 rails) & facilities (15 hospitals/health, 21 schools, 376 settlements, 207 bridges)
blocked_features: GSI 1:50k lithology & thrust-fault GIS (NGDR/Bhukosh auth required)
GSI Landslide Polygon FeatureServer (HTTP 499 token required)
NASA IMERG V07B 2024-06-02..present & SMAP L4 soil moisture (Earthdata token required)
IMD/CWC district rain gauges (non-public institutional feed)

phase_c_spatial_database_schema.details: 19 SQLAlchemy + PostGIS/SQLite-compatible tables across Alembic migrations 0001 -> 0002 -> 0003 with verified upgrade/downgrade tests.

phase_d_ml_quality_gate_and_exploratory_.details: CPU-only RF (ROC-AUC 0.7588) vs XGBoost (ROC-AUC 0.7623) + SHAP + Model B rainfall threshold analysis executed & tested; proved +0.185 corridor-bias inflation. Production ML remains strictly BLOCKED by 6/13 Quality Gate failures.

phase_e_dynamic_hazard_and_exposure_engi.details: 6-part separated dynamic hazard API & real OSM proximity exposure engine; strictly landslide_probability = null, factor_of_safety = null.

phase_f_frontend_geos_v2_hub_and_what_if.details: GEOS 2.0 Research Hub integrated into Sidebar/App with live SoilGrids/OSM/GFS inspection, Recharts SHAP chart, server What-If simulator, in-memory Bearer auth, photo upload field reporting, experimental alerts, and 8-state matrix.

phase_g_grounded_gemini_assistant.details: POST /api/v1/assistant/explain uses gemini-4-hydrogen server-side proxy with prompt-injection screening (HTTP 400), rate limiting, and honest HTTP 503 grounded evidence response when GEMINI_API_KEY is unset.

phase_h_authenticated_field_reporting.details: Authenticated RBAC multipart field reporting with magic-byte JPEG/PNG/WebP validation (<= 5 MB), SHA-256 digests, confined downloads, analyst verification, and audit logging.

phase_i_experimental_alerts_and_dry_run.details: EXPERIMENTAL_RESEARCH_DRAFT creation, review/approval workflow, and DRY_RUN_NO_EXTERNAL_DISPATCH notification logging; zero external public warnings sent.

phase_j_automated_monitoring.details: Cron-compatible run_monitoring_cycle.py and /api/v1/monitoring/status|run logging IMERG staleness & GFS forecast freshness.

phase_k_versioned_api_and_proxy.details: Complete /api/v1/* FastAPI contract + Express full-method/multipart/Authorization proxy in server.ts.

phase_l_security_hardening_and_audit.details: scrypt password hashing, HMAC-SHA256 tokens, first-run admin claim lock, RBAC, upload magic-byte & path checks, hardened backup scripts, prompt guardrails, and bun audit documented.

phase_m_ubuntu_deployment_and_backups.details: docker-compose.yml (3.75 GB max container cap for 8 GB host), Caddyfile TLS proxy, and end-to-end verified backup_db.sh & restore_db.sh.

phase_n_automated_tests_and_benchmarks.details: 34/34 pytest + 9/9 vitest passing, warm latencies 3.4–75.4 ms, peak Python RSS 347.1 MB.

phase_o_8_state_ner_expansion.details: 8 NER states seeded in regional_coverage (1 active pilot: Assam/Dima Hasao; 7 planned states with 0 validated models).
